summary: Every dependency moves to its latest available release — 64 Python packages plus the Node toolchain, including a major bump of the documentation stack and of two transports that sit underneath the MCP server. No shipped API or CLI changes.

highlights.title: The one upgrade that could have broken it
highlights.body: `curl-cffi` went from 0.15.0 to 0.16.3. That package is not a convenience wrapper here: the NovelAI edge sits behind a Cloudflare WAF that rejects clients by TLS fingerprint, which is why every request goes through `create_http_client()` impersonating Chrome. A regression there would not fail a test — it would silently reset connections in production. Verified against the live API: `peet.ws` still echoes a Chrome TLS 1.3 fingerprint (`t13d1516h2_8daaf6152771_806a8c22fdea`), and a real `get_subscription` call returned the same eleven keys as before.

highlights.title: A docs stack that was quietly stuck
highlights.body: The docs project pinned `sphinx>=8.1.3,<9.0`, so `uv lock --upgrade` could never take Sphinx 9 — the ceiling, not the resolver, was holding it back. The ceiling is now `<10.0` and the stack is on 9.2.0. Sphinx 9 qualifies the type names it emits for pydantic field constraints, which silently un-matched a `nitpick_ignore` rule written for bare `Ge`/`Le`/`Gt`/`Lt` and produced thirteen warnings; the replacement rule is scoped to `annotated_types.` so a genuinely missing reference is still reported.

highlights.title: Majors underneath the server
highlights.body: `websockets` 16.1.1 → 17.3 and `cyclopts` 4.23.0 → 5.3.0 arrive transitively through `fastmcp` and `mcp`. Both cross a major version, so the server was exercised end to end rather than only against the suite: 511 tests pass at 85.7% coverage, the three-language documentation builds with `-E -W` and no warnings, and no locale has a dead link.

sections.title: ⬆️ Upgraded
items: Runtime: `fastmcp` 4.1.0 → 4.1.3, `pydantic` 2.14.0a1 → 2.14.1 (the lock was on an alpha), `pydantic-core` 2.47.0 → 2.50.1, `pydantic-settings` 2.14.2 → 2.16.1, `curl-cffi` 0.15.0 → 0.16.3, `msgpack` 1.2.1 → 1.2.3, `typer` 0.27.0 → 0.27.3.
Already newest and left alone: `mcp` 2.3.0, `httpx` 0.28.1, `httpx-curl-cffi` 0.1.5, `argon2-cffi` 25.1.0, `pytest` 9.1.1 and its plugins, `respx` 0.23.1, `reuse` 6.2.0.

sections.title: 🐛 Fixed
items: `nai/imaging.py` unpacked the JPEG SOF segment into an untyped tuple; `pyright` 1.1.414 started rejecting it against the declared `tuple[int, int]` return type. It now unpacks into two named variables, which the type checker can follow.

upgrade_notes: No breaking changes to the shipped API, CLI, MCP tools or documentation URLs. If you vendor this project's lock files, note that `sphinx` now allows 9.x and that two transitive transports (`websockets`, `cyclopts`) crossed a major version. The intentional behaviour change from 0.6.0 still applies: `director_tool`'s `emotion` and `emotion_level` require the `X-MCP-Insiders` opt-in.
